asset: Per-student module completion times and age categories from a fictional online data science course
threat: A small age group lets a reader pick out one student (re-identification)
control: Publish only averages for groups of at least 5 students
residual_risk: A single extreme outlier can still reveal one student's behaviour inside a group of 5

asset: Web server logs of the fictional course website
threat: Logs contain IP addresses that identify visitors
control: Replace IP addresses with salted hashes before analysis
residual_risk: Hashed IDs can still be linked to other datasets that share the same visitor

lesson_section: What you can do with Data
